LanguageData.DMS_Artifuscle.label: Artificial Muscle
LanguageData.DMS_Artifuscle.description: Artifuscle is a prosthetic material grown from genetically engineered stock: bundles of sauropsid muscle fiber sheathed in artificial biological fiber, which gives it a very high compatibility with living tissue. It did not take long for the arms manufacturers to realize what biological-mechanical hybrid technology meant for the future.

LanguageData.DMS_Autofacturer.label: mass production
LanguageData.DMS_Autofacturer.description: Through improved production technology, the material processing and production process can be automated and scaled as much as possible.
LanguageData.DMS_Automatroid.label: Automatroid Basis
LanguageData.DMS_Automatroid.description: These machines are called automatroids because they are not merely a weapon - they are an automatic weapon capable of judging and destroying a target on their own.\n\nA weapon this morally appalling should never have been accepted under normal circumstances, but it was used so widely by every power during the Third World War that it became an ordinary and unavoidable part of the battlefield long ago.

LanguageData.DMS_BattleFrame.label: Battle Friends
LanguageData.DMS_BattleFrame.description: The records are old enough that we have never established whether their proper designation was "battle frames" or "battle friends". Either way they are automatroids, serving as a frame for operating equipment or as a companion in a fight.
LanguageData.DMS_Bionics.label: Biosynthetic Prosthetics
LanguageData.DMS_Bionics.description: As automatroid and bionic engineering advanced, manufacturing bionic automatroids with biological-mechanical hybrid technology became possible.
LanguageData.DMS_DeadMansSwitch.label: Dead Man's Switch
LanguageData.DMS_DeadMansSwitch.description:
The dead man's switch is a mechanical safety mechanism intended to automatically terminate active equipment the moment its operator is incapacitated.

Before mankind explored space, they found that this mechanism would eventually let an artificial intelligence understand, to some degree... the meaning of death.
 That discovery carried mankind into a new era of history...

 the era of the fifth-level artificial intelligence.
LanguageData.DMS_DeadMansSwitch.discoveredLetterText: Some automatroids require specific critical components, and those components cannot be manufactured inside a gravity well.\n\n The colonial fleet has told us we are free to lure in and destroy any automatroid that has left the chain of command in order to obtain them.

LanguageData.DMS_EquipmentAdvanced.label: Defense Equipment
LanguageData.DMS_EquipmentAdvanced.description: Equipment for colony defense and riot control.
LanguageData.DMS_EquipmentBasis.label: Pioneer Equipment
LanguageData.DMS_EquipmentBasis.description: Uniforms and equipment designed mainly for colonial use, including sealed suits for surviving hostile environments.
LanguageData.DMS_EquipmentElite.label: Military Equipment
LanguageData.DMS_EquipmentElite.description: Equipment designed primarily for automatroid use. Most of it is heavy enough that it is unsuitable for a human to handle.
LanguageData.DMS_EquipmentHeavy.label: Heavy Weaponry
LanguageData.DMS_EquipmentHeavy.description: Special equipment built around heavy automatroids and specialized models. No matter how strong a human is, they simply cannot lift it, so it is unsuitable for human use.
LanguageData.DMS_HeavyAutomatroid.label: Heavy Automatroid
LanguageData.DMS_HeavyAutomatroid.description: These heavy machines once stood ready for total war between nations. Fortunately, war on that scale does not happen often.
LanguageData.DMS_HumanoidEngineering.label: Ergonomics
LanguageData.DMS_HumanoidEngineering.description: Humanoid automatroids are humanoid because, compared to other animals, a human is an exceptionally cooperative test subject for training a neural network in a wide range of tactical movements. Humanoid automatroids trained and produced this way also inherit compatibility with human environments and human tools.
LanguageData.DMS_Hybrid.label: Hybrid Engineering
LanguageData.DMS_Hybrid.description: Biological-mechanical hybrid technology was established during the Third World War. Mercenaries from some of the belligerent nations founded an armed state made up of military personnel, meant to secure rights for mercenaries whom the humanitarian conventions had never protected, and used drones and synthetic prosthetics to return discharged wounded veterans to the battlefield.\n\nThe world's militaries soon recognized what biomechanical hybrids meant for modern warfare, and armed their own forces with them.
LanguageData.DMS_Hypothesis.label: Wetware Hypothesis
LanguageData.DMS_Hypothesis.description: After the discovery of the dead man's switch, AI algorithm engineer Yanzhi Jiang proposed a hypothetical solution to the halting problem...\n\nAnd working around that conjecture, we seem to be drawing closer and closer to the so-called universal machine.

LanguageData.DMS_Legion.label: Legion
LanguageData.DMS_Legion.description: A series of automatroids designed for large-scale warfare. Most of them carry only a simple weapon control system, but their clear division of labor and low production cost make them the most impressive combat weapon ever fielded in terms of sheer scale of service.

LanguageData.DMS_Material.label: Material Engineering
LanguageData.DMS_Material.description: "A perfect material can be calculated through scientific method" - one of the major breakthroughs mankind has ever achieved.

LanguageData.DMS_MechBasis.label: Mecha Gear
LanguageData.DMS_MechBasis.description: "Mecha gear" is a term covering the design patterns of modern mechanical engineering. It began as mockery of the exaggerated, unrealistic designs found in science fiction.\n\n After millennia of invention and refinement, however, advanced materials have become the foundation that puts those designs into practice.

LanguageData.DMS_Mechlink.label: Cluster Transceiver
LanguageData.DMS_Mechlink.description: The cluster transceiver is a method humans developed for controlling automatroids in war. For those automatroids that have developed self-awareness, of course, the method is not a comfortable one.

LanguageData.DMS_OrganSurgery.label: Organ Replacement
LanguageData.DMS_OrganSurgery.description: Mankind gave up a great deal in that long war... and even where the loss could later be made good, some things were gone forever.
LanguageData.DMS_Plasfiber.label: Artificial Fiber
LanguageData.DMS_Plasfiber.description: Unlocks the production of artificial fibers. Each of these man-made fabrics has its own advantages and drawbacks.

LanguageData.DMS_Prosthetic.label: Neural Prosthesis
LanguageData.DMS_Prosthetic.description: Neural prosthetics are semi-organic bionic limbs designed specifically for wounded and disabled soldiers. The adaptation training they demand is all but negligible. Out of concern for durability and mass production, however, they do not work as efficiently as the original limb.

LanguageData.DMS_Ronin.label: Specialized design
LanguageData.DMS_Ronin.description: Following the end of the Cold War, rapid breakthroughs in microelectronics freed automatroid configuration and systems integration from the constraints of amorphous neural circuitry. From then on automatroid designs could branch into specialized models at a lower development cost, meeting the low-intensity but complicated demands of the new era of warfare - counter-terrorism, policing actions and the like.
LanguageData.DMS_Synthroid.label: Next-Gen Weaponry
LanguageData.DMS_Synthroid.description: The arms race centered on biological-mechanical hybrids continued all the way to the Fourth World War, and had reached unimaginable heights long before anyone recognized the problem.\n\nWhat followed were the so-called next-generation weapons and the next-generation war they brought with them - a war that very nearly ended Earth.
LanguageData.DMS_UAVBasis.label: Foundational drone tech
LanguageData.DMS_UAVBasis.description: Uses simple control logic and signal transceivers to unlock basic mechanical units.

LanguageData.DMS_Aerospace.label: Advanced control
LanguageData.DMS_Aerospace.description: In the millennium, when printed circuits became widespread, the improvement in computing power and density of microelectronics laid the foundation for more advanced cluster control link integration, and brought possibilities for more intelligent production lines and automatroid designs.
